messages:
olga (producer): Uploaded first cut + transcript for HorizonData case study: https://files.redwood/horizondata-cut1.mp4 + horizon-transcript.txt. Need legal on hero quote, a short benchmark note, and routing for partner leads. Proposed embargo 2025-12-02 09:00 PT.

marta (prod-marketing): Nice. Want a tight hero for landing (<=10 words) and two CTAs: Read the deep dive / Register for migration webinar. We'll also spin a 45s social clip.

olga (producer): Hero candidate from transcript: "Redwood helped HorizonData reduce inference spend 3.7x while stabilizing peak latency." Full quote in transcript.

ben (legal): Quick flags: change exact figure to approximate (~3x) unless finance signs off with dataset. Replace absolutes like "remove" with "reduce" or "helped reduce." Also need signed media release for any telemetry charts.

sam (sales-ops): Routing: when landing form submits, add utm_campaign=horizon-case and route to SDR-Horizon queue; tag partner=horizon if partner leads. Sample curl we will use: ```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/lead-route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-horizon","queue":"SDR-Horizon","partner":"horizon"}'
```

evan (design): I'll mock hero variants and two social cut sizes. Also will create a compact benchmark callout graphic for the blog (aggregated chart, no raw telemetry).

leo (growth): Recommend a follow-up 30-min webinar "HorizonData migration playbook" 10 days after embargo: 2025-12-12 10:00 PT. We'll A/B test landing hero vs CTA-first and track conversion.

marta (prod-marketing): Messaging iteration note: prefer hero to read speaker-forward (e.g., "HorizonData: reduced inference spend ~3x"). We'll run an email subject test too. Olga, can you provide two one-line hero variants by EOD?

olga (producer): Done, uploaded two hero variants in the drive and a 1-pager for CS. Also uploaded a redacted perf appendix: horizon-perf-agg.csv.

ben (legal): I'll approve wording conditional on the appendix attached to the approval email and the signed release. Approved conditional hero: "Redwood helped HorizonData reduce inference spend ~3x while smoothing peak latency." I'll send formal sign-off once I receive the final transcript and release.

sam (sales-ops): Automation plan: when lead.source=="case-horizon" set campaign=horizon-q4-2025; if lead.role=="infra" route to Platform SDRs; attendee-> +25 lead score. I'll smoke-test routing on 2025-11-30 09:00 PT and post results to #sdr-horizon.

evan (design): Mockups posted in #design-requests. Also added a compact footnote style for the benchmark link.

leo (growth): I'll build the landing and UTMs and wire webinar RSVP flow. Olga, please confirm speakers for the webinar so I can add them to the registration block.

olga (producer): Speakers confirmed: HorizonData infra lead, HorizonData SRE, Redwood Solutions Eng. Draft 1-pager for CS is in drive.

marta (prod-marketing): Timeline recap:
- Legal + release attached: by 2025-11-25
- Final edit + social assets: by 2025-11-27
- Landing + routing + smoke test: by 2025-11-30
- Embargo/publish: 2025-12-02 09:00 PT
- Webinar: 2025-12-12 10:00 PT
Flag blockers here.

ben (legal): Sending approval email now; will attach appendix if final transcript present here.

olga (producer): Thanks all. Closing checklist: legal looped, assets uploaded, design mockups done, routing plan in flight. Will post final cut when ready.

deploy-bot: upload complete: horizondata-cut1.mp4 (157MB)

marta (prod-marketing): Nice work. Small brand note: no competitor logos on the landing; partner logo allowed with Copperwell-style co-branding guidelines. Keep embargo tight: only stakeholders on legal email can discuss until 12/02.

sam (sales-ops): Will post smoke test results to #sdr-horizon after 11/30 test.

olga (producer): Closing thread  will ping when final assets + approvals are in.

marta (prod-marketing): End of thread.
